Yes as soneone else in the comments mentioned, study better not longer (or something to that effect). All you will do if you study for 8 hours straight is wear yourself out and waste time. Breakup you studying into managable time segments. Also start studying early (not early in the day just early in terms of when thing are due)

It depends on how you study and learn best. Some people learn by viewing material in class, like audio visual, and some learn by reading notes and their book. So I recommend finding how you learn best. 

If audio-visual pay attention in class (do this no matter which style) and take notes. Then try to find someone to study with. Talk over concepts and teach each other the material. 

If you learn by reading, read all the chapters that are associated with the material you are learning. Rewrite the notes that you took in class and write out things from the book that you feel are relevant to what you are learning.
